projects.name: Enterprise Bank CCTV Infrastructure Upgrade
projects.summary: Enterprise surveillance modernization design involving approximately 54 IP cameras, centralized video management, failover architecture and long-term storage planning.
projects.challenge: Build a resilient centralized surveillance architecture that balances camera count, video management, server failover and long-retention storage.
projects.solution: Developed an end-to-end design covering camera, network, VMS, server and storage layers with high-availability and retention considerations.
projects.outcome: Produced an enterprise solution-design and BOQ framework for a resilient centralized surveillance platform.

projects.name: Large Warehouse Enterprise Wi-Fi Deployment
projects.summary: Designed and supported a high-density wireless solution for a large warehouse and office environment with challenging rack geometry and RF conditions.
projects.challenge: Deliver reliable wireless coverage in an approximately 90 m × 93 m × 13 m warehouse with racks reaching roughly 12 m.
projects.solution: Planned AP placement and models across warehouse, office and outdoor areas, integrated switching/firewall/VLAN design and supported optimization.
projects.outcome: Deployment planning evolved to approximately 49 APs with focus on coverage, capacity and operational reliability.

projects.name: BLE Vehicle Workshop Tracking Solution
projects.summary: Designed a BLE-based vehicle movement tracking concept across an automotive workshop with operational and customer notification workflows.
projects.challenge: Make workshop vehicle status visible across multiple operational stages without relying on repeated manual checks.
projects.solution: Mapped BLE-tracked movement across Reception → Inspection → Service Bay → Quality Control → Washing → Ready → Pickup.
projects.outcome: Created a workflow concept linking physical movement to operational visibility and multi-channel notifications.

projects.name: Enterprise Network Infrastructure Migration
projects.summary: Planned migration and replacement of more than 25 enterprise Huawei switches across core and access infrastructure.
projects.challenge: Replace aging enterprise switching while protecting topology, rack, service and migration dependencies.
projects.solution: Structured the migration around current-state assessment, core/access mapping, BOQ development and coordinated implementation planning.
projects.outcome: Produced a migration-ready technical approach covering equipment, architecture and delivery considerations.

projects.name: Multi-Villa Fiber & Network Infrastructure
projects.summary: Designed an infrastructure concept and BOQ for approximately 30 villas, around 100 network/service points, 30 network racks and a centralized core network.
projects.challenge: The site had no existing fiber infrastructure or usable intermediate manholes.
projects.solution: Developed a new pathway and fiber concept with centralized core architecture and distributed rack planning.
projects.outcome: Created a practical infrastructure and costing framework for a greenfield multi-villa network.

projects.name: ANPR Camera Deployment
projects.summary: Delivered an ANPR implementation covering camera installation, network/IP configuration, loop integration, NVR integration and functional testing.
projects.challenge: Make the camera, network and vehicle-detection loops operate as one reliable event workflow.
projects.solution: Integrated the camera, detection loops and recorder, validated event flow and completed testing/documentation.
projects.outcome: Delivered a completed field implementation with verified detection and recording workflow.

projects.name: Enterprise VLAN & Firewall Architecture
projects.summary: Worked with segmented enterprise networks using FortiGate firewall infrastructure across administrative, guest, CCTV, voice, storage and service domains.
projects.challenge: Separate multiple departments and technology domains while keeping the environment manageable and secure.
projects.solution: Used VLAN segmentation and controlled inter-VLAN access to isolate traffic, improve management and simplify troubleshooting.
projects.outcome: Architecture supports security, traffic isolation, clearer troubleshooting and controlled communication between network zones.

projects.name: Aryvik – AI Voice Assistant & 3D Avatar
projects.summary: Personal AI assistant experiment combining browser voice interaction, neural text-to-speech and a real-time animated VRM avatar on self-hosted infrastructure.
projects.challenge: Synchronize speech, browser interaction and 3D facial animation on lightweight self-hosted hardware.
projects.solution: Built a Dockerized TTS/API service and a Three.js/VRM renderer connected by WebSockets and speech events.
projects.outcome: Working prototype with voice input, neural speech output, avatar mouth movement, facial expressions and remote access.

projects.name: n8n AI Automation Platform
projects.summary: Created and managed a self-hosted n8n automation environment on Raspberry Pi for bots, webhooks, API orchestration and AI workflow experiments.
projects.challenge: Operate reliable automation workflows on a compact self-hosted platform with secure remote access.
projects.solution: Containerized the automation platform and integrated Telegram, webhooks and Tailscale-based access.
projects.outcome: Reusable personal automation platform supporting messaging, API and AI workflow experiments.

projects.name: Raspberry Pi Home Lab & Private Cloud
projects.summary: Built a Raspberry Pi 5-based personal infrastructure lab for Linux, containers, storage, remote access, automation and AI experimentation.
projects.challenge: Combine multiple storage devices and services into a small, maintainable always-on lab.
projects.solution: Organized storage, Docker workloads, remote-access services and application stacks around a Linux-based home-lab platform.
projects.outcome: A practical environment for infrastructure testing, self-hosting, automation and continuous learning.

projects.name: AI / NFC Embedded Technology Lab
projects.summary: Experimental embedded development and NFC testing on an ESP32-S3 wearable platform, positioned as a learning and R&D environment rather than production deployment.
projects.challenge: Understand NFC behavior and embedded constraints on a compact wearable platform.
projects.solution: Iterated firmware builds, debugged hardware communication and tested controlled lab workflows.
projects.outcome: Hands-on embedded systems learning focused on debugging, protocol behavior and device integration.

projects.name: Digital Display & Kiosk Infrastructure
projects.summary: Experience supporting interactive kiosks, non-interactive kiosks, wall-mounted displays, digital signage infrastructure and related network/hardware coordination.
projects.challenge: Coordinate display hardware, network connectivity and operational support across multiple display formats.
projects.solution: Structured device, spare, connectivity and CMS considerations around deployment requirements.
projects.outcome: Supported maintainable digital display and kiosk infrastructure with clear technical documentation.

faq.answer: Amal Dileep is a UAE-based Lead System Engineer working across enterprise networking, IT infrastructure, ELV, CCTV, AV, Linux, Docker, automation and project delivery.
Amal's networking experience includes Huawei switching, Aruba networking, FortiGate, VLAN architecture, routing and switching, enterprise Wi-Fi, migration planning and troubleshooting.

Highlighted work includes enterprise CCTV/VMS design, warehouse Wi-Fi, network migration, multi-villa fiber, ANPR deployment, VLAN/firewall architecture, Aryvik AI, n8n automation and a Raspberry Pi home lab.

Amal works across requirement analysis, site surveys, solution architecture, product selection, BOQs, costing, OEM/distributor coordination, technical proposals, tender support, scope definition and project methodology.
You can contact Amal at amaldileepofficial@gmail.com, connect on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/amal-d-57421a130, or view GitHub at github.com/amaldileep-tech.
